description: This file defines the ShoppingCartDao interface, which declares methods for accessing and manipulating ShoppingCart entities in the data layer, including retrieval by ID, customer, or code, and removal of a shopping cart.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access methods for ShoppingCart entities, including retrieval by various criteria and deletion.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a ShoppingCart by its ID within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieve a ShoppingCart associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a ShoppingCart by its unique code within a MerchantStore.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieve a ShoppingCart by ID without collection objects for performance or serialization reasons.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a ShoppingCart by code without collection objects.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Remove a specified ShoppingCart from persistence.
